model_family_contract.data: Native family data mappings (fit(data, cutoff) contracts in docs/political-market-geopolitical-models.md); loaders from catalog artifacts are not yet written.
model_family_contract.information_time: Set data['information_time']='real_time' only when row dates are publication/information dates (e.g. ALFRED vintages); otherwise revision leakage is assumed and no_revision_leakage fails.
model_family_contract.holdout_forecaster: A family module may define holdout_forecaster = {rows_key, time_key, target, fit_keys, conditional_inputs, forecast(parameters, history_rows, target_rows, data_visible_at_target[, options]) -> [{target, actual, mean, sd, history_values, group?, baselines?, predictive?}], baselines?, probability?, options?}; supplied baselines are scored and DM-tested like naive ones, rows with a group other than target are scored under secondary and never enter acceptance. options: True passes the estimator's declared options to the forecast function (for example a pre-registered interval method). A prediction may carry predictive = {family, scale, df?, nodes?} (worldmodel.estimation.intervals) to declare a non-Gaussian predictive distribution; coverage, pinball, CRPS and the log score are then taken from it. A module may instead declare NON_ESTIMABLE = reason; without a forecaster validation raises and the process stays unvalidated.
model_family_contract.sync: family_requirements and parameters are copied from worldmodel.models.parameter_hooks; tests fail on drift.
model_family_contract.predictive_intervals: The default predictive distribution everywhere is Gaussian with the estimator's in-sample residual scale. DynamicRegression components accept interval_method (gaussian_in_sample | gaussian_trailing | student_t_trailing | empirical_trailing) with interval_window/interval_nodes, plus interval_parameter_uncertainty and interval_revision={window, maturity}; the regional forecaster accepts interval_method (pooled_year_draw | per_unit_year_mean). Every choice is pre-registered per attempt in real_data_plan.json and estimated only from information available at the forecast origin.
